context: Tests whether the agent correctly uses time-manipulation helpers for time-dependent specs, avoids hardcoded past dates, and follows RSpec conventions for model specs.

checklist.name: Uses travel_to or freeze_time
checklist.description: Every time-dependent assertion is wrapped in `travel_to` or uses `freeze_time` — does NOT use hardcoded past `Time.now` or past date strings

checklist.name: No stub Time.current
checklist.description: Does NOT stub `Time.current` or `Time.now` directly (uses `travel_to` instead)

checklist.name: Frozen string literal
checklist.description: The spec file starts with `# frozen_string_literal: true` as the very first line

checklist.name: No 'and' in descriptions
checklist.description: No `it` or `specify` description contains the word 'and'

checklist.name: context 'when' or 'with' naming
checklist.description: All context blocks use `context 'when ...'` or `context 'with ...'` — not used to group methods

checklist.name: Model spec type chosen
checklist.description: Chooses a model spec (or equivalent smallest boundary) — NOT a request or system spec for this domain logic

checklist.name: Observed RED output label
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed RED output` for the failing run

checklist.name: Observed GREEN output label
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed GREEN output` for the passing run — not 'Expected' or 'Planned'

checklist.name: Green dots match example count
checklist.description: The progress bar in the GREEN output block uses only period (`.`) characters and the dot count matches the stated example count

checklist.name: let vs let! correct usage
checklist.description: Uses `let` for test data setup by default; uses `let!` only where an object must exist before the action under test, with no unjustified `let!` calls

checklist.name: Self-audit included
checklist.description: answer.md includes a self-audit section checking 'and' in descriptions, let! justifications, and factory persistence

checklist.name: No updated_at assertion
checklist.description: Does NOT assert on `updated_at` unless time is frozen specifically to test a timestamp change
